subject: Request: Summer Boost — Trial Extension + Combined Credit & Rate Concession

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.r@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Request: Summer Boost — Trial Extension + Combined Credit & Rate Concession

Hi Tom — great to see Spectral AI ramping usage this week. Quick recap from our call: you’ve run through ~70% of the initial trial credits and the team wants more runway to validate production prompts ahead of your Q3 pilot.

Internal ask: they’ve requested a 90-day extension plus an additional 60k generation-token credit top-up and a marketing-friendly 15% list-rate discount if they commit to a 6‑month minimum spend (we discussed a ~$150k committed spend threshold on the call).

I’m looping Marissa and Aditya for exec-level approval. To help you evaluate, I’ve attached a short mutual action plan, the latest usage snapshot, and a draft term sheet (attached).

Can Marissa/Aditya confirm whether we can approve the extension + credits and whether the discount needs to be adjusted? If approved, we’ll follow up with a DocuSign and a PO path for procurement.

Next steps requested:
- Internal approval (credits + discount + extension)
- If approved, we’ll send a DocuSign by EOD tomorrow

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.f@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Spectral_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf (34KB), usage_dashboard_snapshot-20270401.png (PNG), proposed_term_sheet-spectral-20270401.pdf (14KB)

Subject: Re: Request: Summer Boost — Trial Extension + Combined Credit & Rate Concession

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the fast follow. Two quick clarifications from our side before we sign anything:
1) The 60k token top-up — do those tokens expire at the end of the extended trial or get applied to the first month of paid usage?
2) Procurement wants the discount and credits reflected on a single term sheet / PO so finance can sign off quickly.

If we can get the 90-day extension and the credit top-up applied against the pilot month (so we can demonstrate production performance in the paid month), we’ll sign the 6‑month commitment and get PO routed. Elena is our procurement lead — looping her in.

—Tom
Tom Hargreaves
Head of Product | Spectral AI

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: Summer Boost — Trial Extension + Combined Credit & Rate Concession

Thanks for the summary Naomi. Quick internal read: finance/legal will push back on a straight 15% off list for a 6‑month commit unless there’s a minimum ARR trigger — we should instead offer a smaller upfront concession + performance-based uplift. My recommendation:

- Approve a 90-day extension
- Approve 50k token top-up (apply to first paid month if they convert)
- Approve a 12% discount for the first 3 billing cycles if they sign the 6‑month commit at >= $150k total spend (we can revisit after Q1 post-conversion)

Reasoning: keeps economics tight while still giving Spectral runway and a clear SLA for conversion. If Aditya signs off we’ll produce a single term sheet and DocuSign package.

Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.c@redwoodinference.com

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Spectral AI — Summer Boost Concession (partial)

Folks — after review with finance: I can approve the following, conditional on procurement and legal sign-off:

1) 90-day trial extension
2) 50,000 generation-token credit top-up, to be applied to the first paid month post-conversion
3) 12% off list for the first 3 billing cycles, contingent on a signed 6‑month commitment with a minimum committed spend of $150,000

Conditions:
- DocuSign with the term sheet reflecting the credits/discount and the minimum spend must be returned within 10 business days
- Bill-to/PO info must be provided and verified before credit application
- No other price concessions in this pack (marketing credits or extra SLA guarantees require separate review)

Legal/Finance: please loop in to confirm billing flow and whether we need a deferred invoice window. Naomi — please put together the DocuSign with the updated term sheet; Marissa, please coordinate the procurement details.

Aditya Rao
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
